evidence.title: Greenidge Generation rebrands as Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, targets AI/HPC

summary: Greenidge Generation announced it has changed its name to Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, signaling a strategic shift toward serving the growing demand for artificial‑intelligence and high‑performance computing workloads. The rebrand emphasizes the company’s focus on providing dedicated power and infrastructure solutions for data‑intensive operations.
title: Greenidge Generation rebrands as Vulcan Infrastructure and Power, pivoting to AI and HPC markets
